CustomField.formula:
IF( OR( CONTAINS(Opportunity__r.RecordType.DeveloperName, 'FRPSA'), AND( CONTAINS(Opportunity__r.Lender_Account__r.Name, 'Quick Bridge'), Contract__r.Product_Type__c = 'FRPSA' ) ), 'FRPSA',
IF( CONTAINS(Opportunity__r.RecordType.DeveloperName, 'Lease'), 'Lease',
IF( OR( CONTAINS(Opportunity__r.RecordType.DeveloperName, 'MLP'), AND( CONTAINS(Opportunity__r.Lender_Account__r.Name, 'Quick Bridge'), ISPICKVAL(Opportunity__r.Actual_Payment_Frequency__c,'Monthly') ) ), 'MLP',
'Loan'
)))
CustomField.label: Product
